description: No clean concept found. Weakly more likely to fire when there is an immediate win or must-block cell in column 4, or when columns 2-3 stand at least two stones taller than columns 1 and 4 with same-colour horizontal pairs across columns 2-3. Most firing is not explained by these; activation is highly conjunctive and depends on move order.
effect: Very small: forcing it high raises columns 1 and 4 by a few points and lowers columns 3, 6 and 0 by a few points; zeroing changes probabilities by under 0.1.
notes: Tried: last-move horizontal O window (F1 0.06), any open horizontal two (0.06), cols 2-3 tower+pairs (0.08), col-4 win/must-block (0.118), OR of the last two (0.119, AUROC 0.56, simulation share 0.03). Minimal pairs show strong conjunctive and move-order effects (same board, different order: 0.91 vs 0.31). Likely a random direction or a mixture. Synthesis reaches 8.96 vs dev max 6.0.
